normalisation.emissions_reference: Each model's source-defined all-industry no-CE GHG
normalisation.emissions_context_reference: Unplotted OMNIA three-sector context uses combined cement, steel and aluminium no-CE GHG

notes: OMNIA-ENGAGE aggregates EUE, EUM and EUW; GCAM selects its EU-27 aggregate once, without adding the country rows.
The OMNIA EU regions include Greenland, Faroe Islands, Andorra, Monaco and San Marino in the supplied country mapping; these cannot be removed from regional data.
GCAM source LTT scenarios are paired with OMNIA baseline (NDC+LTT); the scenario names alone do not establish identical policy assumptions.
Historical bars use OMNIA 2019 and GCAM 2021 observations separately; no interpolation or historical alignment is imposed.

GCAM reports cement, steel and aluminium output without exported clinker or primary/secondary route splits. Aluminium route coverage remains unconfirmed and is not assumed equivalent to OMNIA primary plus secondary.
GCAM aluminium energy includes an Unallocated residual between the reported sector total and its reported carrier parents; the residual is not assigned to an unreported carrier.

GCAM aluminium's alumina-refining coverage is unconfirmed. The energy residual has no confirmed process attribution, and cross-model energy/output quotients are apparent ratios rather than harmonised efficiency measures.

Industrial GHG boundaries differ: OMNIA reports Emissions|GHG|Industry; GCAM combines industry energy-demand Kyoto gases with industrial-process Kyoto gases. GCAM has no comparable cement/steel/aluminium GHG decomposition.
Every response uses the same model, climate pathway, sector and comparison-year no-CE total as its denominator.

Component values are signed percentage-point contributions: 100 times the component CE-minus-no-CE change divided by the no-CE sector total. Net values use the same calculation for the sector total and are percentages.
GCAM metal output has no exported primary/secondary route split. Its single reported-metal contribution does not establish equivalent route coverage across models.
GCAM aluminium energy retains an Unallocated contribution from reported sector total minus reported carrier parents; no process or carrier attribution is assumed.
Incomplete inputs retain the source adapter's explicit missing-activity treatment. Nonfinite or nonpositive no-CE sector totals produce gaps for every contribution and net response.
No historical bars or absolute quantities are plotted. Their raw comparison-year values remain in the source CSVs.
All six production panels share one percentage scale; all six energy panels share another common percentage scale.
Production plots only the net response; route contributions are exported as context to avoid implying matching GCAM routes.
Emissions panels a,b compare reported all-industry totals only; OMNIA selects Emissions|GHG|Industry directly, including sectors beyond cement, steel and aluminium.
OMNIA-only three-sector responses and industry decompositions remain unplotted CSV context with ContextOnly=True and Plotted=False.
GCAM provides partial sector CO2 variables but no matching cement/steel/aluminium GHG totals; these are not substituted for GHG.
Under the configured zero policy, missing NDC+LTT aluminium GHG in all three OMNIA EU regions is provisional zero in unplotted sector context; it does not replace the reported industry-parent inputs.
The companion absolute-value figures remain in report_figures_europe_comparison_261014.
